models.notes: Primary candidate. The hash is the upstream LFS object id, so a re-download can be checked against it without trusting this machine. Q4_K_M rather than a lower-bit quant because every field that matters here is a number and digits degrade first. Context is 8192 rather than the model's native 32768: recaps are short, the longest case in the set is a three-deep email thread, and a smaller KV cache leaves headroom on 16 GB.

The phase 7 comparison model. Half the parameters at the same quantisation, so the axis under test is model size with everything else held fixed: same grammar, same prompt, same sampling, same context.
